title: 'The reports should be managed properly' must not be dropped
whyThisCase: First dropped-content bug: this sentence was in the stored extracted text but never became a requirement unit (11 sentences → 20 units instead of 21). Coverage was treating it as skippable commentary. It must be extracted AND flagged as a vague verb. HasActor is false (thing-as-subject); Phase 4 flagged the verb, not actor-undefined. actorChecks records that as a documented tradeoff so it does not look like an undefined-actor miss.

mustExtract.note: The sentence that used to vanish during extraction.

ambiguities.note: Manage/managed without an operation list (create, export, archive, …).

actorChecks.note: HasActor=false is the same documented quality-score limitation as the prohibition sentence. Not a planted actor-undefined issue.
